entities.name: Visigothic Kingdom of Toledo
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Germanic Visigoths' kingdom centred on Toledo, Reccared's conversion to Catholicism (589), the Councils of Toledo, the Visigothic legal code (Liber Iudiciorum), and the kingdom's collapse before the Umayyad invasion.
